title: The constant-sheaf cohomology equivalence of an isomorphism of geometric fibers
statement:
Let $k_0,k'_0$ be finite fields and let $\ell$ be prime and invertible in both.
Let $X_0/k_0$ and $Y_0/k'_0$ be schemes with quasi-compact, quasi-separated, locally
finite-type structure morphisms, and let $e:\overline Y\xrightarrow{\sim}\overline X$
be an isomorphism of their geometric fibers [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Define
$e_i:H^i(\overline Y,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)\xrightarrow{\sim}
H^i(\overline X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$, with cohomology as in
[def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology], by identifying both groups with homology of
derived global sections of the constant adic sheaf [def-weil-constant-weil-structure],
then applying the exact pushforward equivalence $e_*$, its constant-unit isomorphism,
and the canonical global-section composition isomorphism. These comparisons define
a specific linear equivalence and contain no unspecified choice of a cohomology map.

source.place: Proof, item (6), canonical identification of geometric fibers and the induced cohomology identification

proof.text: Identify the underlying Weil cohomology carrier with homology of derived global sections of the actual constant adic unit. Use the derived forgetful comparison and exactness of sections at the algebraically closed point, then the canonical derived-composition comparison.

Pushforward along the given geometric isomorphism is an exact equivalence, with the specified constant-unit isomorphism. Compose its right-derived global-section comparison with the unit isomorphism, apply homology, and conjugate by the carrier identifications of the first step. This is the actual Lean construction; no arbitrary cohomology equivalence is selected.

lean.statement:
def cohomologyLinearEquivOfGeometricFiberIso
    (k k' : Type u) [Field k] [Finite k] [Field k'] [Finite k']
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ l)] [Fact (ringChar k' ≠ l)]
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k'))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k'))] [QuasiSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k'))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k'))]
    (e : (Y ↘ Spec (.of k')).geometricFiber ≅ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).geometricFiber) (i : ℤ) :
    ((WeilSheaf.adicConstant k' l Y).cohomology i).carrier ≃ₗ[PadicAlgCl l]
      ((WeilSheaf.adicConstant k l X).cohomology i).carrier
